documents.title: Бухарское ханство — договорный переход в вассальную зависимость от России в 1868 году
documents.institution: Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
documents.notes: Institutional chronology states that the 23 June/5 July 1868 peace treaty made Bukhara a Russian vassal and that territories acquired from Bukhara in 1868–1870 formed the Zeravshan district. Used as an interpretation cross-check, not as the sole legal source.

documents.title: Секретные дополнения к условиям мира России с Бухарой 1868 года

date.original: май–июнь 1868 г.; приняты вместе с условиями мира 23 июня OS

authority: Российская империя / К. П. фон Кауфман
documents.publicationCitation: Published with the 1868 Russian-Bukharan peace conditions in the Russian imperial documentary corpus reproduced by Восточная литература.
documents.notes: The secret supplement expressly frames the emir's payment and obligations as a sign of his desire to live in friendship with the Russian Empire and to acquire the protection (покровительство) of the Russian Emperor; it also obliges the emir to police the border while the Turkestan Governor-General undertakes to strengthen friendly relations. This supports a source-verified dependency/protection relationship, but not an assertion that Bukhara became ordinary Russian sovereign territory or that a fully codified protectorate regime existed in a single article.

documents.title: Заключён Гендемианский мирный договор между Россией и Хивой
documents.institution: Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
documents.notes: Institutional chronology states two different territorial statuses: Khiva became a Russian vassal, while the khanate's right-bank Amu Darya lands passed directly to Russia. Retained as an interpretation cross-check after the official treaty text was indexed separately.

documents.title: Ферганская область — образование из присоединённого Кокандского ханства
documents.institution: Президентская библиотека имени Б. Н. Ельцина
documents.notes: Institutional chronology identifies the Highest Order of Alexander II by which the territory of the Kokand Khanate entered Russia and was reorganized as Fergana Oblast. Retained as a cross-check after the RGVIA original/PSZRI decree was indexed separately.
